insurer_name: Cholamandalam MS General Insurance Company Limited
specific_diseases_listed: Rheumatism and arthritis of any kind
Diseases of ears / tonsils / adenoids / paranasal sinuses / deviated nasal septum
Stones in urinary and biliary systems
Benign cyst, nodule, polyp, tumour, breast lump
Intervertebral disc prolapse / degenerative disc disorders
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Super top-up pays only over the aggregate deductible per policy year. PREMIERE plan excludes pre/post-hospitalisation; SUPREME plan includes 60-day pre and 90-day post hospitalisation.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Covered above deductible up to Sum Insured.
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Includes room, ICU, OT, surgeon, anaesthetist, drugs, implants, donor harvesting expenses.

day_care_treatments.limit_text: 141 listed day-care procedures covered up to SI above deductible.

domiciliary_treatment.notes: Covered if condition prevents transfer or hospital bed unavailable; excludes asthma, arthritis, hypertension and other listed chronic conditions.

ayush_coverage.notes: Inpatient AYUSH treatment in recognised AYUSH hospital, up to SI above deductible.

organ_donor_expenses.notes: Donor in-patient hospitalisation expenses covered for harvesting organ for insured.

ambulance_cover.notes: Road ambulance reimbursed on submission of original bills; cashless not available.

permanent_exclusions: Rest cure, rehabilitation, custodial / respite care
Obesity / weight-control surgery (unless BMI/comorbidity criteria met)
Breach of law, intentional self-injury, attempted suicide
notable_exclusions_summary: Top-up only pays above the aggregate deductible. Standard health-insurance exclusions apply (cosmetic, weight-control without criteria, change-of-gender, hazardous sports, alcohol/drug abuse, self-inflicted, breach of law). PED waiting 36 months; specific-disease waiting 12 months.
claim_process_summary: In-house claim settlement team; helpline 1800 208 9100; WhatsApp 7305234433. Deductible applied aggregate per policy year before insurer pays.
